comment: Source of truth for the AxeUI C API. include/ui/ui.h and the TypeScript/Dart bindings are generated from this file by tools/gen_api.py; CI fails if they are out of date. See docs/architecture.md, 'Language bindings'.

enums.name: error_code
enums.doc: Result of every fallible function. Mirrors ui::foundation::ErrorCode.

values.name: ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE
values.doc: Null handle, or one never issued.

values.name: ERROR_WRONG_HANDLE_TYPE
values.doc: Refers to a different kind of object.

values.name: ERROR_WRONG_THREAD
values.doc: Called from a thread that does not own the context.

values.name: EVENT_LOG
values.doc: A diagnostic (when no log callback is set): level, code, message.

values.name: EVENT_FRAME_REQUESTED
values.doc: The surface wants a frame: call ui_surface_frame() at its next vsync.

fields.name: min_log_level
fields.doc: Diagnostics below this level are dropped.

structs.name: surface_desc
structs.doc: A host-owned drawable area (window, view, canvas) registered with ui_surface_create().

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: Physical pixels per logical pixel, in [1/64, 64].

structs.name: allocation_stats
structs.doc: Memory allocated by a context. The caller sets size; the library fills the rest.

structs.name: event
structs.doc: One engine-to-host event. The caller sets size; the library fills the rest.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: EVENT_LOG: the error code (UI_OK for information).

fields.name: message
fields.ownership: Owned by the context; valid until the next ui_context_poll_event() or ui_context_destroy().
fields.doc: EVENT_LOG: UTF-8 text of message_length bytes (not NUL-terminated); NULL otherwise.

callbacks.name: log_callback
callbacks.doc: Receives diagnostics, including invalid handles passed to the API. Called on the owning thread, possibly while the engine is dispatching.

callbacks.name: event_callback
callbacks.doc: Optional convenience: receives events immediately instead of queuing them for ui_context_poll_event(). Called on the owning thread, possibly while the engine is dispatching.

callbacks.name: wake_callback
callbacks.doc: Called by ui_context_wake() on the calling thread, so the host can interrupt its own event wait. Must be thread-safe and must not call the API.

functions.name: get_version
functions.doc: The version of the linked library, packed like UI_MAKE_VERSION. Compare with UI_VERSION to detect a header/library mismatch.

functions.name: error_code_name
functions.doc: Stable name of an error code ("UI_ERROR_STALE_HANDLE"); "UI_ERROR_UNKNOWN" for unknown values.

functions.name: context_create
functions.doc: Creates a context. The calling thread becomes its owner: every other function taking this context must be called on that thread, except ui_context_wake().

functions.name: context_destroy
functions.doc: Destroys a context and everything in it. NULL is ignored. Must not be called from inside a callback.

functions.name: context_set_log_callback
functions.doc: Routes diagnostics to callback (NULL: they are queued as UI_EVENT_LOG instead).

functions.name: context_set_event_callback
functions.doc: Delivers events to callback immediately instead of queuing them (NULL: queue).

functions.name: context_set_wake_callback
functions.doc: Sets the host's thread-safe wake-up hook used by ui_context_wake(). Set it before other threads may call ui_context_wake().

functions.name: context_poll_event
functions.doc: Removes the oldest queued event into out_event. Sets out_event->type to UI_EVENT_NONE when the queue is empty.

functions.name: context_wake
functions.doc: Thread-safe: queues one UI_EVENT_WAKE (coalesced) and calls the wake callback. The only function that may be called from any thread.

functions.name: context_get_allocation_stats
functions.doc: Memory currently and historically allocated by the context.

functions.name: surface_create
functions.doc: Registers a host-owned surface. The engine will ask for its first frame with UI_EVENT_FRAME_REQUESTED.

functions.name: surface_destroy
functions.doc: Unregisters a surface. Called during dispatch (from a callback), destruction is deferred until dispatch ends; the handle is stale immediately.

functions.name: surface_resize
functions.doc: Reports a new physical size and scale factor.

functions.name: surface_frame
functions.doc: Delivers the frame requested with UI_EVENT_FRAME_REQUESTED. timestamp_ns is the host's monotonic clock.

functions.name: utf8_to_utf16_offset
functions.doc: Converts a byte offset into UTF-8 text to the matching UTF-16 code-unit offset. Fails with UI_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT for invalid UTF-8 or an offset that is not on a code-point boundary.

functions.name: utf16_to_utf8_offset
functions.doc: Converts a UTF-16 code-unit offset to the matching byte offset into UTF-8 text. Fails with UI_ERROR_INVALID_ARGUMENT for invalid UTF-8 or an offset inside a surrogate pair or past the end.
